## About Bolmen

The surface area of Lake Bolmen is 173 km2, which makes it the twelf largest lake in Sweden [@SMHI_2008; @Klante_2023]
Here should be some basic information about the lake. 
This part should contain: 

- basic information like 
    - size
    - retention time
    - max. depth
    - mean depth
- a (interactive) map with sampling locations, maybe as GoogleEarth Link
- some general information like e.g. imporant industry
